entries.result: You receive news that a suspect has been arrested for a crime unrelated to the Case.
Strange lights are seen in the sky, or on the outskirts of Town.
An envelope with strange photographs is left for you.
You are harassed by a person who apparently has nothing to do with the Case.
You see someone acting normally; when they realize they are being watched, they run away!
Someone slips a map to a place on the outskirts of Town into your pocket.
An airplane’s turbine falls on a house. Fortunately, no one gets hurt.
Someone approaches you with the printed copy of a coded message, in which you can only identify your name.
Suddenly, someone starts to sing and/or dance for no apparent reason.
You are approached by a person whose testimony denies everything you know so far.
You receive news that a chest/safe has been found, but its owner is unknown.
Strange transmissions are captured on TV and/or radio.
You receive news that a suspect has been murdered.
